1753-2105-5144-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1753-2105-5144-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-2105-5144-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

862-997-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
862-997-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

678-5865-8250.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
678-5865-8250.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax.
Repeat.

4279-4976-7192--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4976-7192--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

147-5100-5147.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5100-5147.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1379-1669-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-1669-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing that creature, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.

2921-4419--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

423-907-1437-6628--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-907-1437-6628--85.description:
Cast PuPu UFO by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the PuPu UFO spell three times.
Resolve the first PuPu UFO copy.
Activate the PuPu UFO's first ability by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4742-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1061-4603-7060.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-4603-7060.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-4603-7060.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Stormchaser Drake

1525-2031-2406-2660-7193.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-7193.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

2511-4875-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
2511-4875-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2173-2511-5010-5708.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

2034-3375-3693-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2866-3200-4986-5147.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

6798-6872--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
6798-6872--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

198-3918-5200.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Trazyn and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on Trazyn.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
198-3918-5200.notes: The mana cost of this combo is {3} if Trazyn has no charge counters to start, {1} if it has one charge counter, or {0} otherwise. Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1563-2079-2457-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1-2428-5436-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2428-5436-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

907-1479-1817.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-1817.description:
Cast Kodama of the East Tree either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Kodama of the East Tree spell, with the copy not being legendary.
Resolve both Kodama of the East Tree spells.
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Repeat from step 7.

609-859-4613.notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
609-859-4613.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Mine Worker's ability by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2573-3946-4011.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Aerie Ouphes

3388-3575.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature with flying on the battlefield.
3388-3575.description:
Activate Moritte of the Frost by sacrificing it, targeting any creature with flying.
When Moritte dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Choose to have Moritte of the Frost enter the battlefield as a copy of Aerie Ouphes with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter on Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Moritte abilities, dealing infinite damage to the targeted creature(s).

482-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eyeblight Cullers, adding {C}{C}.
When Eyeblight Cullers dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Eyeblight Cullers trigger, creating three 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Eyeblight Cullers from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

464-1861.easyPrerequisites: Fraying Sanity is attached to an opponent.
464-1861.notablePrerequisites: Optionally, you control an additional creature with power 2 or greater.
464-1861.description:
Cast Cut Your Losses by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing an opponent to mill half their library, rounded down.
At the beginning of your end step, Fraying Sanity triggers, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the number of cards put into their graveyard this turn.
